purpose: Teach: 属する/従う/密接/超過/所在/着手/急増/取り上げる

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、組織に、絶対、属する、絶対、者として、絶対、責任を、絶対、果たします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: As a member of the police force, I will fulfill my responsibilities with complete seriousness and dedication.
lines.style: Formal, measured tone. Even cadence — each phrase deliberate and weighty. Slight pause between major ideas. Eyes steady, shoulders back. The gravity of an oath being taken.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の指示に、本気で、絶対、従う、絶対、所存です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I fully intend to follow the police department's guidance.
lines.style: Respectful, controlled nod in the voice. Quiet affirmation — not enthusiastic, but genuinely compliant. Even rhythm. Slight lean forward to show attentiveness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察と地域、本気で、絶対、密接、絶対、な、絶対、連携、絶対、保っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police and community maintain close, seamless coordination.
lines.style: Official register — steady, assured. No flourish. Each word lands with equal weight. The tone of someone reporting facts, not selling a vision. Composed breath beneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警備予算、本気で、絶対、超過、絶対、ないよう、絶対、調整しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We adjust our security budget to ensure we never exceed our allocation.
lines.style: Professional update, efficient. Slightly faster pace than before — matter-of-fact. No hesitation. The voice of someone reporting numbers that are in order.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の、本気for、絶対、所在、絶対、市民に、絶対、明らかにしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police make their location and operations transparent to the public.
lines.style: Formal statement of policy. Deliberate, precise articulation. Slight emphasis on 'public' — the audience of this accountability. Composed, unbending.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規捜査に、本気で、絶対、着手、絶対、警察、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've initiated new investigations in response to these concerns.
lines.style: Status update delivered with quiet confidence. Slightly quicker clip — action being reported. No apology, no hedging. The tone of someone showing they are doing the work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害件数、本気で、絶対、急増、絶対、警察、絶対、対応強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The number of incidents has increased, and we are strengthening our response capacity.
lines.style: Factual, grave. The words are serious but delivered without melodrama. Slight weight on 'strengthening' — showing forward momentum. Composed professionalism.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民の声を、本気で、絶対、取り上げる、絶対、警察様、絶対、姿勢、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful for the police's commitment to genuinely listening to the voice of the community.
lines.style: Sincere appreciation — quieter, less ceremonial than earlier. Genuine warmth beneath professional respect. Slight softening of the jaw. The warmth of someone who means what they're saying.
